info.title: Elysion public API
info.description:
The versioned API of Elysion for scripts and integrations (ADR 0033). How to get a token and make the first call: docs/api.md.

- **Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with a personal access token (`elp_...`), an integration's Keycloak token or a person's own Keycloak token. A token acts as its person or integration and never sees more; each route also needs a scope.
- **Errors** are problem details (RFC 9457, `application/problem+json`).
- **Lists** are pages: `?limit=` (1 to 200, default 50) and `?cursor=` (the `next` of the page before; `null` on the last page).
- **Rate limit**: per credential, 600 requests a minute by default; every answer has `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`, a refused one `429` with `Retry-After`.
- **Bodies** are JSON of at most 1 MiB.
- **Not in v1**: writing elements; renaming, deleting and restoring versions and opening one as a new board; webhooks.

bearer.description: A personal access token (`elp_...`) or a Keycloak access token.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the status says what happened.

title.description: The standard text of the status.

detail.example: This needs a token with the scope "boards:write".

code.description: Elysion's own code where a client may act on it: `account-deactivated` for a deactivated owner.

tokenId.description: The id of the personal access token; null for a Keycloak token.

created.description: When the file was added, in milliseconds since 1970.

url.description: Where the bytes are: a public API route that needs `boards:read`. Never inline.

roomId.description: The room the board is in; null for none.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last one.

elements.description: The live elements in drawing order, as Excalidraw stores them (deleted ones are left out).

files.description: The files the elements show, by id, as links.

email.description: The email of the person; or `userId`.

userId.description: The id of the person or integration; or `email`.

role.description: The caller's role in the room.

kind.description: `Manual`: saved by somebody; `Auto`: kept by Elysion; `BeforeRestore`: the state before a restore.

name.description: Optional; without it the version is unnamed.
